name: MusicSegment
doc: A playable section with synchronized stems on one tempo map.

fields.name: bars
fields.doc: Length in bars; the follow-up starts on the last bar line.

fields.name: tempo
fields.doc: Tempo map; empty is 120 BPM in 4/4. The first change must be at bar 0.

fields.name: next
fields.doc: Weighted follow-ups; empty repeats this segment.

fields.name: loudness
fields.doc: Cooked integrated loudness of the full mix (all stems), so a loudness-targeted bus trims every stem equally. Measure with measure_mix_loudness.
